templates.narrative: Cancelled all occurrence of Part II Order Number {cancelled.no} dated {cancelled.date}

slots.label: Order being cancelled
slots.help: The published order you want cancelled: its number and date. Pick it from your vault or type them. Left blank, the slip prints a blank to fill in.

templates.certificate: Certified that the previous status may be restored due to cancellation of Part II Order No {cancelled.no} dated {cancelled.date}

templates.narrative: Cancelled occurrence at Ser No {cancelled_serial} of Pt II order No {cancelled.no} dated {cancelled.date}

slots.label: Order being corrected
slots.help: The published order that holds the wrong occurrence: its number and date. Pick it from your vault or type them. Left blank, the slip prints a blank to fill in.

slots.label: Code of that occurrence
slots.help: The code printed on the occurrence you want cancelled, for example GTDAL.

slots.label: Its serial in that order
slots.help: The serial number the occurrence carries in the published order. Read it off the order, not off your own draft.

templates.certificate: Certified that the previous status may be restored due to cancellation of Sr No {cancelled_serial} of the Part II Order No {cancelled.no} dated {cancelled.date}
